data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, my top recommendation is **1Password Business**\. It offers the best overall balance of security, ease of use, shared credentials, and administrative controls.

However, if your team is particularly budget-conscious, **Bitwarden Teams** is an excellent alternative.

The right choice depends on how many people you have and how you share access to company accounts.

## Best options compared

| Password manager | Best for | Approx. starting price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **1Password** | Best overall experience | C\$29.95/month for 10 users |
| **Bitwarden Teams** | Best value | US\$4/user/month |
| **Keeper** | Budget-conscious small teams | C\$3/user/month |
| **Dashlane** | Credential-risk monitoring | Higher-priced business plan |


Prices are indicative, based on 2026 published pricing, before taxes. [www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[velotouch.com](https://velotouch.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My shortlist

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — Best overall**

- Very intuitive for non-technical employees.
- Shared vaults for departments and projects.
- Strong access permissions and admin controls.
- Canadian company with a Canadian data-region option.

My first choice for a typical small business.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden — Best value**

- Excellent shared collections.
- Open-source software.
- Strong security and administrative features.
- Great if you don't mind a slightly less polished interface.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — Best for structured administration**

- Shared folders.
- Detailed access management.
- Good options for organizations with compliance requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

## What I'd look for

Regardless of which one you choose, make sure it supports\:

- Individual employee accounts (never one shared master login).
- Shared company vaults.
- Permission controls by employee or department.
- Immediate access removal when someone leaves.
- Two-factor authentication.
- Secure sharing of API keys, Wi-Fi passwords and other secrets.

## My recommendation

If I were setting up a business with 5–20 employees, I'd start with 1Password Teams Starter Pack. It's a particularly attractive option for teams of up to 10, without paying for the full Business tier.

I'd choose Bitwarden instead if keeping recurring costs low is the priority.

**One question so I can narrow this down\:** How many people will need access?

- 1–5
- 6–10
- 11–25
- 26–50
- 50+

I can then recommend the best plan and estimate the actual annual cost in Canadian dollars.
